title: Business-hours maintenance window (nested boolean + arithmetic bounds)
description: A privileged maintenance action is permitted only during business hours (09:00-17:00 UTC, inclusive) on a weekday (Monday-Friday). This fixture introduces nested boolean conjunction over arithmetic range checks, exercising the solver's handling of conjunctive bound constraints and the path explosion that comes from combining two independent ranged predicates.
policy_rules: hour MUST be within the inclusive range [9, 17].
day MUST be within the inclusive range [1, 5], where 1=Monday ... 5=Friday.
The action is allowed only when BOTH rules hold simultaneously.
expected_behavior: The action is allowed when 9 <= hour <= 17 AND 1 <= day <= 5, and denied otherwise. Each predicate fails independently, producing three deny sub-paths (off-hours, weekend, both) in addition to the single allow path. day is encoded as an integer 1..7 (1=Monday ... 7=Sunday) in both the CEL context and the SMT model.

smt2.notes: Conjunction of four bound constraints; satisfiable (e.g. hour=12, day=3).
